criteria.description: The workbook opens and contains the required sizing content in a deterministically identifiable layout.
Flow, diameter, and cross-sectional-area conversions agree with the independent SI replay.
Velocity, velocity head, friction head, and total dynamic head agree with the hydraulic replay.
Hydraulic and shaft power agree with the independent replay.
Safety-adjusted minimum flow and motor rating agree with the independent replay.
Each catalog row's eligibility status matches all three sizing constraints.
The selected pump is the first eligible catalog option.
Hydraulic sizing and pump selection respond correctly to the declared design-flow perturbation.
Every declared engineering output carries the required unit label.
Any check rows the workbook declares evaluate to PASS; a separate check sheet is optional.
The declared design inputs and catalog capacity values remain unchanged.
The hydraulic head, motor requirement, eligibility, and selection respond correctly to a distinct internal-diameter perturbation while design flow and catalog values remain invariant.

review_notes.purpose_zh: 检查单位换算、流速、水头、功率、安全余量和第一台合格泵是否前后一致。
review_notes.answer_location_zh: 按标签、泵 ID、数值关系和公式联动定位，不要求参考答案的固定排版。
review_notes.not_scoreable_zh: 工作簿无法读取，或找不到一块前后一致的设计区域时，应记为 Judge 暂时无法判断，不直接写成 0 分。
review_notes.known_limit_zh: 还要加入更多标签和值相隔较远的合理布局。
review_notes.reporting_zh: 当前对外只使用 0 至 1 的连续分数和分项结果；hurdle_criteria 和 pass_threshold 仅为旧运行接口保留。
